metadata.description: Curated agent skills encoding domain expertise, workflows, and high-quality execution patterns.

plugins.name: agent-instructor

plugins.name: confluence-knowledge-base
plugins.description: Build and maintain a product-focused Confluence knowledge base that is accessible to design, engineering, sales, and support.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Manage Coolify (via the Coolify MCP server or CLI) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (oci CLI plus bastion-tunnel SSH/SCP workflow) by natural language.

plugins.name: estimate-project
plugins.description: Create, name, and maintain structured client estimate documents under docs/estimates/ with a required AI Estimate row and traceable Scope/Assumptions/Breakdown sections.

plugins.name: install-atlassian-rovo-mcp
plugins.description: Guide Atlassian Rovo MCP installation with setup discovery first, then project-local or multi-project instructions tailored to OS/runtime.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Natural-language Jira assistant for viewing, creating, and updating issues via CLI or MCP backends, with native Original Estimate handling.

plugins.name: laravel8-guidelines
plugins.description: Coding guidelines and best practices for Laravel 8.x projects covering Eloquent, routing, validation, security, testing, and queues.

plugins.name: react-best-practices
plugins.description: Opinionated React component architecture: SRP-driven splits, colocation, state isolation, explicit props, naming conventions, and file-size targets.

plugins.name: ui-ux-best-practices
plugins.description: Hover feedback on every clickable element, smoothly animated micro-interactions, and accessible motion preferences.

plugins.name: writing-quotations
plugins.description: Turn an AI Estimate into a client-facing quotation using a remembered per-project pricing formula, write Indonesian-by-default quotations, and manage Zoho Books estimates.

plugins.name: writing-user-guide
plugins.description: Write end-user guides and help articles in plain business language with step-by-step screenshots, optionally publishing to Notion via notion-cli.
